不可携带受抚养子女（dependent children）一同赴澳。官方原文 `: Do not bring dependent children with you to Australia. The official wording `not be accompanied by dependent children` (Work and Holiday visa (subclass 462) — First Work and Holiday visa, sources[1]) is defined by dependency, not by age; the earlier phrasing 'children under 18' is not retained.
学历/在读门槛不在官方公开规则里：⚠️ 官方页未提及在读/毕业时间要求，也未设学: The education/enrolment threshold is not in the published official rules: the official page states no enrolment or graduation timing requirement and sets no degree threshold; that threshold is set by national committees and by each posting during recruitment. The claim 'master's students must stay enrolled, graduates must apply within 2 months' comes from a third-party summary page and has no counterpart in the official material, so it is not used.
不可携带被抚养者同行。原记录「不可携带被抚养的子女或不带家属随行」句内「或」连接: Dependants may not accompany you. The previous wording ('may not bring dependent children, or does not bring dependants') joined a prohibition and a statement with 'or' and was not grammatical, so the scope is set from the official source already cited by this entry: sources[2] (2026 working holiday visa guide, Japan-Taiwan Exchange Association) lists 'no dependants accompanying' among the eligibility conditions — the object is dependants in general (spouse and children), not children only. sources[0] (MOFA page) does not list a dependant clause, so it is not used to narrow this.
不可携带子女。伴侣同行需各自申请（后者另立一条程序约束，见下一条）。: Dependent children may not accompany you. A partner may accompany you but must apply separately (recorded as a separate procedural requirement below).
伴侣可同行，但须各自单独递交申请，不能作为随行家属一并办理。: A partner may accompany you, but must submit a separate application rather than being processed as an accompanying dependant.
一生只能申请一次（官方原文 `You can only apply for an: You can only apply once in your lifetime (official wording `You can only apply for an HPI visa once.`).
已经拿过毕业生签证（Graduate visa）或曾以 Doctorate Ex: Anyone who has already held a Graduate visa, or who came to the UK as a student under the Doctorate Extension Scheme, cannot apply. The bar covers these two named routes, not any UK visa.
官方两条硬性排除，措辞是「有未成年子女同住」（`children under t: Two official hard exclusions, worded as having children under the age of 18 who live with you, and children you're financially responsible for — the test is whether you are in that situation, not merely whether you bring children along. Note: the third official exclusion, `already been in the UK under the scheme` (once in a lifetime), is unrelated to dependants and is recorded separately.
官方第三条硬性排除：`already been in the UK under: Third official hard exclusion: `already been in the UK under the scheme` — anyone who has previously taken part in the scheme in the UK cannot apply again, i.e. once in a lifetime.
申请 OPT（递交 I-765）时须持有效 F-1 学生身份，且该身份在递交当日: When applying for OPT (filing I-765) you must hold valid F-1 student status and that status must still be valid on the filing date; you must also have completed at least one full academic year of full-time enrolment at an SEVP-certified school (8 CFR 214.2(f) tests F-1 status only and sets no nationality restriction). Applicants whose status has lapsed or who have never held F-1 cannot apply. This item is not a US residential address requirement.
递交 I-765 时本人须在美国境内；从境外无法递交。本项是所在地要求，与持何种: You must be physically inside the United States when filing I-765; it cannot be filed from abroad. This is a location requirement and is separate from which visa status you hold.
